name: Palau Nightjar
rangeDescription: Palau (western caroline islands)
description: A small grayish-brown nightjar with a chestnut neck, back, and central tail. Note the white throat patch and white tips to outer tail and wings in flight.

name: Spot-winged Starling
rangeDescription: Foothills of northern india and nepal; winters to myanmar and thailand
description: Uncommon pale-eyed starling with a white patch on each wing. Male is metallic dark blue-gray above with an orange breast and belly.

name: Yellow-crowned Parakeet
rangeDescription: North island, south island, stewart island, and auckland islands (new zealand)
description: A small, rare, bright green parakeet endemic to New Zealand. Recognized by its yellow crown and the thin red band that stretches to both red eyes between the crown and the base of the beak.

name: Kinglet Manakin
rangeDescription: Coastal southeastern brazil (bahia to rio de janeiro)
description: Chunky little, short-tailed bird of lowland and foothill forest. Male is distinctive with bright red crown and bold white stripes on reddish belly.

name: Hume's Boobook
rangeDescription: Andaman islands
description: A medium-sized, dark brown owl with distinctive yellow eyes. Note the small white spot between the eyes.

name: Black-throated Shrikebill
rangeDescription: Mountains of larger fiji islands
description: A distinctive shrikebill; male is large and brown with a striking black face, a pure white ear patch, and a heavy, upturned bill. Female much plainer, with mostly brown plumage.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Thick-billed Seed-Finch
rangeDescription: Southern mexico (veracruz) to western colombia and western ecuador; also coiba and pearl islands
description: Small seed-eating bird of humid tropical lowlands; uncommon. Found in damp grassy areas, overgrown weedy fields, and forest edges, often in areas with scattered bushes and small trees.

name: Campina Thrush
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia eastward to southern venezuela and guyana, southward locally to central amazonian brazil, from the east bank of the río madeira to the east bank of the río tapajós
description: A drab thrush, uncommon in open habitats and woodlands in the lowlands. Nondescript grayish-brown with a pale whitish belly.

name: Black-headed Heron
rangeDescription: Grassland and savanna of sub-saharan africa
description: A large, grayish heron of drier habitats; note distinctly dark cap and nape contrasting with white throat. In flight the underwing is strongly contrasting black-and-white.

name: Gibberbird
rangeDescription: Stony plains of central australia
description: Brightly colored, terrestrial songbird with upright posture found in arid stony plains of central Australia. Grayish brown above, yellow below, with yellow face and notably pale eye (Yellow Chat male has a completely yellow head).

name: Black-tailed Crake
rangeDescription: Northeastern india and myanmar to southwestern china and northern southeastern asia
description: Small dark crake found in highlands and foothill regions, where it inhabits forested marshes, flooded fields, and wet shrubby patches. Rich brown above and dark gray below.

name: Obi Golden-Bulbul
rangeDescription: Obi (northern moluccas)
description: A thrush-sized bird with a heavy bill, olive-green upperparts, and a yellow underside. Particularly note the yellow cheeks and the yellowish patch beside the bill, making the dark eye stand out from the face.

name: Christmas Island Frigatebird
rangeDescription: Christmas island; ranges to southern china sea and australia
description: One of the largest of the frigatebirds; females are larger than males. Adults are easier to separate from similar frigatebirds than younger birds.

name: Spangled Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Northeastern new guinea (montane forest of huon peninsula)
description: A large, common, honeyeater of montane forests on the Huon Peninsular. Blackish with a paler throat and long tail.

name: Ayacucho Antpitta
rangeDescription: East slope of the andes of south-central peru (ayacucho, west of the río apurímac between the río mantaro and río pampas)
description: Medium-sized antpitta found only in a small area of the eastern Andes in south central Peru, not far from the city of the same name. Plumage is rich chestnut-brown with a hint of buff on the belly.

name: Bolivian Antpitta
rangeDescription: East slope of the andes of northwestern bolivia (la paz, cochabamba, and adjacent santa cruz)
description: Rotund, brown bird with long legs and a short tail restricted to the Bolivian Andes. Looks rather plain in the field, though may show a buffy tinge to the underparts.

name: Sjöstedt's Greenbul
rangeDescription: Locally in cameroon, equatorial guinea, western gabon, and northeastern democratic republic of the congo
description: A unusual dark greenbul often found near water in the forest interior. Decorated in various shades of dark and olive green, with a gray throat that contrasts with the breast, a buffy belly, and bright white sides of the tail.

name: Purple-crowned Plovercrest
rangeDescription: Eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina (misiones) to southern brazil
description: Medium-sized charismatic hummingbird with an iridescent green body and short, straight bill. Males have a violet-blue crest and are violet below with light gray flanks.

name: Plumbeous-crowned Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia to ecuador and southern peru (cusco)
description: Small uncommon flycatcher in the subtropical zone of the Andes from Colombia to Peru. It has a pale yellow belly, gray crown, dark ear patch, and yellow edges on the wing feathers.

name: Gabela Akalat
rangeDescription: Angola (humid montane forest of gabela escarpment)
description: A rather small, demure understory denizen resembling a cross between a robin and a flycatcher. Mostly dull brownish-olive with a rusty rump and a paler throat and belly.
